title: Touhou Hisoutensoku ~ Choudokyuu Ginyoru no Nazo o Oe - Dichromatic Lotus Butterfly ~ Ancients (SMW-Mix)
description:
𝓤𝓷𝓯𝓸𝓻𝓽𝓾𝓷𝓪𝓽𝓮𝓵𝔂 𝓯𝓸𝓻 𝔂𝓸𝓾, 𝓘 𝓭𝓸𝓷'𝓽 𝓹𝓪𝓻𝓽𝓲𝓬𝓾𝓵𝓪𝓻𝓵𝔂 𝓶𝓲𝓷𝓭 𝓷𝓮𝓮𝓭𝓵𝓮𝓼𝓼 𝓴𝓲𝓵𝓵𝓲𝓷𝓰.

A remix of Reimu Hakurei's theme song in Touhou 12.3: Hisoutensoku, Dichromatic Lotus Butterfly ~ Ancients. When will I stop making remixes of Touhou songs?

This song is a great fit for forest and grassland stages.
